description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven ranged single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking] based on entry element damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Faris] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Faris
description.text: Increases [Fire/Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire or Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Faris after using a Fire or Wind ability (max 5), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Pirate Cannon+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.10 each), causes [ATK and MAG -50% (8s)], grants [ATK and MAG +50% (8s)] to self

description.name: Serpent's Gale+
description.text: Five single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ users

description.name: Spirit Attack: Faris
description.text: Causes [DEF and RES -50% (8s)], grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
